subject: Lease renewal: please decide by December 1
summary: Hillcrest asks Alex to choose a lease renewal by December 1: 12 months at $2,140 or 6 months at $2,260.
reason: A decision is requested by a firm deadline, and the unit will be listed if Alex doesn't respond.
body_text:
Dear Alex Rivera,

Your lease at 412 Alder St, Unit 3B ends January 31. Please choose a renewal option (12 months at $2,140 or 6 months at $2,260) by December 1. If we don't hear from you, the unit will be listed.

Hillcrest Property Management
